change_request.reason: Implementation diverged from plan - hardcoded domain tabs instead of freeform
change_request.original_implementation: Hardcoded tabs (Architecture, Design, Testing, Security) with typed editors per domain
change_request.required_implementation: Dynamic tabs from specification keys + KeyValueEditor for freeform fields + AddDomainPopover for custom domains

summary.goal: Extend StepEditor with tabbed specification sections supporting freeform domains (suggested: Architecture, Model, Design, Testing, Security) per step
summary.context: Each step can have its own micro-specifications detailing architecture decisions, data model schemas, design elements, test cases, and security requirements relevant to that step. This is step-level (not plan-level) specification. Schema is freeform - any domain, any fields.
summary.freeform_rationale: Different steps need different domains. The Orchestrator is an LLM that can understand any JSON structure. Suggested domains are for convenience but users can add custom domains.

acceptance_criteria.description: StepEditor expanded view shows tabs: Details + dynamic domain tabs from specification
Details tab contains existing step fields (description, dependencies, acceptance criteria, gate)
'+' button after last tab allows adding new domain (suggested or custom)
Each domain tab uses KeyValueEditor for freeform fields
Suggested domains (Architecture, Model, Design, Testing, Security) shown in add popover
Empty tabs show 'Add [domain] details' CTA with suggested fields as hints
Tabs with content show dot indicator on tab label
Inline editing for all spec fields (draft plans only)
Changes auto-save via debounced PATCH
Step header shows small icons indicating which spec domains have content
